suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53514 / GHSA-fmh4-wcc4-5jm3: unauthorized organization-invitation acceptance via unverified email match in better-auth's `organization` plugin. Confirmed against the advisory (github.com/better-auth/better-auth/security/ advisories/GHSA-fmh4-wcc4-5jm3): it explicitly requires the `organization` plugin to be active. atlas-backend's src/services/auth.service.ts only registers `plugins: [expo()]` -- `organization` is never imported or configured anywhere in this codebase, so the vulnerable code path is unreachable. No patched version fixes this for us either: the advisory's patched version is 1.6.11, but the affected range resumes at >=1.6.14 under some configs, so pinning to a version 12 releases behind current isn't a real fix -- it would just trade this for whatever 1.6.11 lacks. Re-check this suppression if/when the organization plugin is ever added (tentatively Epic 12 -- Group Trip Voting).
